title: Rory and the Gentle Glowworm Grove
verses:
The moon floated over the river so wide,
And painted the valley in blue,
As Rory walked down to the shimmering side,
Where blossoms were covered in dew.

Then Ricky hopped over a soft mossy log,
While Nia flew down through the air,
They guided their friends past the sleepy old bog,
To find a warm resting spot there.

Psittaco was chirping a lullaby song,
High up in a canopy tree,
As Benny swept slowly and trotted along,
As happy as any could be.

And Tilly knelt down on the velvety grass,
Where glowworms shone bright in the shade,
She watched the calm ripples of light as they pass,
Across the sweet cozy old glade.

Then Rory lay down with his chin on his chest,
As darkness crept over the hill,
The dinosaur friends were all ready to rest,
And everything turned soft and still.

The stars shone like lanterns of silver and white,
Above where the valley slept deep,
The forest was washed in the softest moon light,
As Rory fell softly to sleep.
